### [Claude Haiku 5.5](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/7/claude-haiku-5-5/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-07

Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, a fast reasoning model priced at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens for contexts under 100,000 tokens, matching OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna.

- Base pricing is $0.10/$0.50 per M tokens up to 100k tokens, increasing 5x to $0.50/$2.50 above 100k, with a new tokenizer that uses ~1.25x more tokens than Haiku 4.5.
- Reasoning cannot be disabled and defaults to medium effort, with configurable levels ranging from low to max.
- Anthropic halved Sonnet 5.5 cache read prices and added non-rollover monthly API credits for Max ($100-$200) and Team (up to $500) subscribers, matching subscription costs.
- Anthropic introduced an API feature to disable auto-reload, stopping requests when credit balances run out to prevent overage charges.

**Why it matters:** Haiku 5.5 drastically lowers the cost of low-latency reasoning workloads while integrated subscription API credits make platform experimentation risk-free for existing subscribers.

`anthropic` `claude` `llm-pricing` `ai`
